name: cliamp
author: Jan Renz
description: A window for cliamp, the terminal music player Omarchy already installs: radio, podcasts, live radio for your country, and your queue — with cliamp's own spectrum in the bar. Starts cliamp headless when nothing is playing yet, so the bar works whether or not a terminal player is open. No account, no API key, no setup.

barWidget.description: Now playing with cliamp's spectrum; click opens the library window.
